title: Generating sets of standard modules for $D_4^{(1)}$
summary: Let $\widetilde{\mathfrak g}$ be an affine Lie algebra of type $D_4^{(1)}$ and $L(Λ)$ its standard module of level $k$ with highest weight vector $v_Λ$. We define Feigin--Stoyanovsky's type subspace as $W(Λ)=U(\widetilde{\mathfrak g}_{1})\,v_Λ$, where $\widetilde{\mathfrak g}=\widetilde{\mathfrak g}_{-1}\oplus\widetilde{\mathfrak g}_{0}\oplus\widetilde{\mathfrak g}_{1}$ is a $\mathbb{Z}$-gradation of $\widetilde{\mathfrak g}$ associated with a $\mathbb{Z}$-gradation $\mathfrak g=\mathfrak g_{-1}\oplus\mathfrak g_{0}\oplus\mathfrak g_{1}$.
